category_spanning_reviewers: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE category = 'office products' AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM reviews WHERE category != 'office products' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM products WHERE category = 'office products'))
office_product_reviewers: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reviews WHERE category = 'office products'
multi_category_reviewers: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reviews WHERE ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM products WHERE category = 'office products') AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM reviews WHERE category != 'office products' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM products WHERE category = 'office products'))
all_reviewers_count: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reviews WHERE category = 'office products'
category_count_per_user: SELECT r1.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r1.ref_id) as product_count FROM reviews r1 GROUP BY r1.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r1.ref_id) > 1
